takedown.title: Takedown & corrections
takedown.description: Take my account down, the wrong account is linked to me — how to ask, and how fast it is handled.
takedown.intro: {brand} only lists accounts that were made public on the show or set to public by the person themselves. Even so, if you want yours down, we take it down. Photos too. We do not ask why.
requests: Remove or fix my real name, age, or job
An account that has nothing to do with me is linked to my name
The program, the season or the name is wrong
takedown.requestsNote: You can report the last two even if you are not the person involved. One wrongly linked account sends a flood of DMs to someone with no connection to the show, so we are glad to hear about it.
takedown.howBefore: Email the address below. Two lines is enough —
takedown.howWhat: the program, the season and the name
takedown.howMiddle: (e.g. I Am SOLO Season 28 Yeongsuk), and
takedown.mailSubject: [Takedown/Correction] Please include the program, season and name
takedown.verifyBody: We have to stop pranks that ask us to take down someone else's account, so the fastest route is anything showing the account is yours — DM us from that Instagram account, or email from the address attached to it. Even when that is hard to confirm, we take it off the site first and talk afterward.
takedown.timeBody: Once confirmed, we delete it right away. You will hear back within 7 days at the latest. Accounts and photos we have taken down never go back up.
takedown.translationNote: This English text is a translation. Where the two differ, the Korean original governs.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What this site publishes, and what it keeps about visitors.
privacy.cast1: We publish the name used on the show (some programs use aliases), the real name where it is already public, the age and job at the time of airing, public Instagram accounts, and when and how each account was verified. Photos are sometimes included.
privacy.cast2: All of it comes from the broadcast and from public sources — never collected from the person directly. Private accounts and unverified guesses are not published. If you ask us to take something down, photos included, we do it without asking why.
privacy.visitor1: There are no accounts and no logins. No screen on this site asks for your name or contact details.
privacy.visitor2: We use Vercel Web Analytics for traffic stats. Which pages were opened, where visitors came from, and rough device and browser types are counted anonymously. These stats use no cookies and do not identify visitors individually.
privacy.visitor3: If you email us, your address and message stay in that mailbox. We delete them once the request is handled.
privacy.processor: Hosting and traffic stats run on Vercel Inc. (USA). Visiting the site leaves an access record there. Ads are served by Google LLC (USA). Nothing is handed to or sold to anyone else.
privacy.ads: We show ads through Google AdSense. Google and its advertising partners may use cookies to select ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can turn personalized ads off in Google's ad settings.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct, or delete information about yourself. We do not ask why, and once it is confirmed we delete it right away.
privacy.translationNote: This English text is a translation. Where the two differ, the Korean original governs.
